children: Ford Motor Company (NYSE:F) faces safety and political pressure as recalls and NHTSA probes target F‑150 and Edge models, while the company doubles down on U.S. manufacturing—owning battery plants, investing $1B in a Kentucky paint shop for the 2027 Fathom and preserving ~2,200 jobs.
: Ford recalls about 223,472 2023–2027 F‑150s for potentially leaking or unsecured fuel tanks that could detach, raising stall or fire risk; dealers will inspect and replace tank straps free.
: Ford (F) says it will build and operate US battery plants, owning the facilities and workforce, rejecting claims they were joint ventures.
: Ford (F) to invest $1B in a new paint shop at Kentucky Truck Plant; groundbreaking by late 2026. Upgrade supports 2027 Fathom electric pickup production and secures about 2,200 jobs.
: Political scrutiny targets Ford Motor Company (F): Senate and House critiques of its China ties, a high-profile committee report, and White House defense noting domestic investment and production.
: NHTSA opened a defect petition for about 499,603 Ford Edge (2015–2018) with 2.0L EcoBoost, citing coolant intrusion into the engine — key safety risk traders should note.
